definitions: A South American plant with bright orange, yellow, or red flowers and peppery-tasting leaves, used in salads.
A genus of flowering plants in the family Brassicaceae, known for their edible leaves and flowers.
examples: The nasturtium leaves added a peppery flavour to the salad.
She planted nasturtiums along the edge of the vegetable patch.
The vibrant nasturtium flowers were a beautiful sight.
